contradicting_evidence: Current participation is constructive in USD terms: 68% of the freshest breadth universe is advancing, and observed large-, mid- and small-tail proxy medians are positive.
ETH outperformed BTC over the supplied 24h window, while the mid-alt proxy median also exceeded BTC's return. This is a potential starting point for broader improvement.
The latest hourly price declines and open-interest reductions are modest, not evidence of an accelerating market-wide liquidation.
The 90d constituent snapshot still shows positive median alt returns; weak relative leadership does not mean all longer-window absolute returns are negative.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: The low-confidence expectation is renewed net weakness over the week, potentially interrupted by rebounds and stabilization attempts. Contracting liquidity capacity and negative settled flows weigh against durable expansion unless fresh demand and persistent participation emerge. This is not a forecast of uninterrupted selling or uniform weakness across assets.
falsification_conditions: Sustained BTC and ETH gains accompanied by persistent broad relative outperformance would contradict the downside forecast even before slower liquidity data fully update.
Improving settled ETF flows together with stablecoin-supply stabilization and stronger ETH/BTC would materially weaken the liquidity-led downside thesis.
missing_evidence: Additional settled ETF sessions to determine whether the latest outflows persist or reverse.
Fresh stablecoin observations and evidence of actual deployment, rather than supply alone.
Persistent ETH/BTC leadership, comparable breadth history and coverage beyond the Top-100 proxy.
Updated macro and catalyst evidence relevant to the coming week.
supporting_evidence: Stablecoin supply declined approximately 1.88% over 7d and 3.64% over 30d, with a further 0.58% daily decline. This is a negative liquidity-capacity backdrop, though not direct proof of selling.
The latest settled BTC and ETH ETF session was materially negative for both assets, providing observed demand-side counterweight to the rebound.
The 30d constituent snapshot shows only 13 of 49 alts outperforming BTC and a median alt return near -20.77%, versus BTC near -8.88%. Broad relative repair has not been demonstrated.
Current broad USD advances are not matched by broad benchmark outperformance: the older constituent snapshot has only 40 of 100 outperforming BTC and 32 outperforming ETH.
